product.title: Full Day: Christ Redeemer, Sugarloaf, City Tour & Barbecue Lunch

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this full-day van circuit travels through Tijuca Forest, stops at Centro De Visitantes Paineiras, and continues to Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer. The published route then uses the Morro da Urca cable car toward Sugarloaf Mountain and adds Maracana, Sambodromo da Marques de Sapucai, the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian, and Escadaria Selaron. Copacabana Beach, Ipanema Beach, and Avenida Atlantica appear as pass-bys. Hotel pickup is listed from South Zone and Barra da Tijuca hotels, with a published 8:30 a.m. start. Christ the Redeemer van admission is included; Sugarloaf tickets and barbecue lunch appear only on the upgraded full option. The format suits visitors who want a guided landmark day without coordinating forest, cable-car, and downtown timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on Paineiras, Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain, and the Sambodrome that shape this outing rather than a private custom circuit.
